title: Grab bars and seats.
officialText:
Grab bars and seats for showers, including those within a toilet and bathing room accessed
through a private office by a single occupant, shall comply with Sections 609 and 610 of ICC A117.1 and shall be provided in
accordance with Sections 608.2.3 and 608.3 of ICC A117.1.
Exception: Grab bars and seats are not required to be installed where reinforcement for such grab bars and seats is
installed and located to permit future installation of grab bars and seats complying with Section P102.9.2.1.
SECTION BC P103
REFERENCED STANDARDS
